title: MLOPS↔DEVOPS-001: Model Artifact → OTA Distribution Pipeline
description: MLOps hands an OTA-ready model artifact (+ rollout strategy + distribution metadata) to DevOps; DevOps returns per-cohort distribution status and rollout progress. Grounded in MLOPS_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.2 (Model Artifact OTA Coordination). The artifact's full manifest validates against OTA_COMPATIBILITY_MANIFEST_SCHEMA (OCM).

model_id.description: Model identifier transitioning to the 'Production' registry stage.

artifact_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the model artifact; DevOps re-verifies at the distribution endpoint.

max_flash_budget_bytes.description: Maximum flash consumption permitted on target.

ocm_reference.description: Reference to the full OTA Compatibility Manifest (model.id + model.version) validated against OTA_COMPATIBILITY_MANIFEST_SCHEMA.

mlops_signature.description: MLOps signature over the artifact bundle.

deployment_intent.description: Rollout intent communicated within 1 business hour of registry stage transition to 'Production'.

distribution_status.description: Returned by DevOps (Requires side of §6.2): per-cohort distribution status.

percent_on_new_version.description: Percentage of target devices running the new model version.

hash_verified_at_endpoint.description: True when SHA-256 received at endpoint matches registered artifact.

x-macp.tier_rationale: Part of the OTA strategy chain (permanent HITL gate). Urgent hotfix dispatch and rollback triggers are security/OTA-relevant.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (handoff within 1 business hour of Production stage; DevOps acks + begins packaging within 2 business hours); SLA_FROM_EVENT (status every 4h active / 24h observation); urgent hotfix 1-hour end-to-end timeout
confirm_conditions: artifact_sha256 verifies at the distribution endpoint
ocm_reference resolves to a valid OCM with flash_budget_check.result = PASS
all dqir_clearance IDs in the OCM are resolved
rollout_strategy has a canary_percentage in 1–100 and defined rollback triggers
reject_conditions: an unresolved DQIR is listed in dqir_clearance
counter_conditions: deployment_intent = URGENT but observation_period_hours implies a slower schedule — request reconciliation
OCM flash_budget_check.result = WARN (80–95%) — request explicit risk acceptance before staged rollout
